name: 12 Pcs Mocallure Matte Liquid Lipstick Set | High-Pigment, Waterproof & Long-Lasting
description:
The 12 Pcs Mocallure Matte Liquid Lipstick Set delivers vibrant, high-pigment color with a smooth matte finish. Lightweight, waterproof, and long-lasting, these lipsticks ensure your lips stay bold and beautiful all day. With 12 versatile shades ranging from nudes to reds and maroons, this set is perfect for daily wear, parties, or professional events. The non-sticky, quick-dry formula provides comfortable, glamorous lips effortlessly.
Key Features
 12 shades in one set – natural nudes to bold reds and maroons
 High pigmentation for rich color payoff in one swipe
 Waterproof and long-lasting formula for all-day wear
 Lightweight, non-sticky, and quick-dry texture
 Perfect gift for makeup lovers and professionals
How to Use
 Apply directly to clean, dry lips
 Start from the center and glide towards edges
 Let it dry for a smooth matte finish
 Reapply as desired for deeper color
Material
High-pigment cosmetic oils, colorants, and moisturizing agents
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 12 × Mocallure Matte Liquid Lipsticks
